company.title: Industrial safety from Forge Public Safety
company.description: Forge Industrial Safety extends the Forge platform with survey and compliance tools for industrial operations.
paragraphs: Safety managers use Forge Industrial Safety to run structured assessments, capture findings in the field, and track corrective actions to closure.
Built with the same security and role-based access standards as the Forge public safety platform.
Teams roll out by facility or region with template configuration and assessor training included in implementation.
company.closingDescription: Request a demo to see survey templates, field capture, and compliance reporting.
